# Slash commands

**Accepted** lists the places where the command acts.
**Refused** lists places that reject it instead of sending it to the model.
At a task or steer input, a word in neither column is plain text.
The CLI menus also check for unknown command words.

- **start**: the first task of a run.
- **plan/ask**: the first task of a plan or ask.
- **pause**: the CLI pause menu.
- **steer** and **resume**: the TUI and web composers for a live or ended run.
- **script**: `agent6 steer`.
- **acp start** and **acp**: the editor's first prompt and its later prompts.
- **parent**: a steer sent by a parent to a child, always text.
- **child**: the task in a child's launch file.
- **run -i**: the commit prompt.
- **ask -i**: the interactive ask prompt.
- **next**: the end-of-session prompt, which refuses a lone slash word except `/undo` and `/exit`.

A valid opening `/parallel` is text in a plan, an ask or a child's task.
The editor offers child dispatch only in modes that can dispatch work.
The web composer withholds `/undo` under model git control.
Use the name of an enabled skill in place of `/<skill>`.

| Usage | Help | Kind | Accepted | Refused |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>/&lt;skill&gt; [args]</code> | use an enabled skill as the instruction | sets state | acp, next, pause, resume, script, steer | - |
| <code>/answer &lt;question-id&gt; &lt;text&gt;...</code> | answer a question (pause menu: /answer lists questions, /answer ID asks one) | sets state | acp, pause | acp start |
| <code>/btw &lt;question&gt;</code> | ask a question beside the run: /btw &lt;question&gt; (answers inline, later) | starts a session | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/compact [focus]</code> | compact the context now; /compact &lt;focus&gt; steers the summary | controls the run | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/continue</code> | resume the run unchanged (same as Enter) | controls the run | pause, run -i | - |
| <code>/cost</code> | print the token and cost summary | opens a view | ask -i, run -i | - |
| <code>/detach</code> | keep the run going in the background | controls the run | pause | - |
| <code>/diff</code> | show the diff from the base commit to the run branch tip | opens a view | run -i | - |
| <code>/exit</code> | stop the session and leave the prompt | controls the run | ask -i, next, pause, run -i | - |
| <code>/findings [--all]</code> | List this run's open review findings | opens a view | acp | acp start |
| <code>/fix &lt;finding-id&gt;... --resume &#124; --all --resume</code> | Resume an idle session to reproduce stored findings; leaves them open | starts a session | acp | acp start |
| <code>/help</code> | list the commands at this prompt | opens a view | pause, run -i | - |
| <code>/init</code> | run the setup wizard in the current directory | sets state | run -i | - |
| <code>/mcp</code> | list the MCP servers and tools in this run | opens a view | run -i | - |
| <code>/metric [off &#124; SPEC]</code> | Show, set, or turn off the run metric. | sets state | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/now &lt;text&gt;</code> | steer at once, aborting the call in flight: /now &lt;text&gt; (Ctrl+Enter on the web) | controls the run | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/parallel [SPEC --] TASK</code> | dispatch children: /parallel [SPEC --] TASK (SPEC: count or models; repeat to queue more) | starts children | acp, acp start, next, pause, resume, run -i, script, start, steer | - |
| <code>/pin &lt;text&gt;</code> | pin an instruction that survives compaction: /pin &lt;text&gt; | sets state | acp, next, pause, resume, script, steer | - |
| <code>/quit</code> | stop at this prompt | controls the run | ask -i, run -i | - |
| <code>/receipt</code> | Inspect recorded testing, review and reversal evidence | opens a view | acp | acp start |
| <code>/reopen &lt;finding-id&gt; --reason &lt;text&gt;</code> | Reopen a finding with a reason | sets state | acp | acp start |
| <code>/reset</code> | clear the prior questions and answers | sets state | ask -i | - |
| <code>/resolve &lt;finding-id&gt; --as &lt;disposition&gt; --reason &lt;text&gt; [--duplicate-of &lt;id&gt;]</code> | Resolve a finding with the operator's disposition and reason | sets state | acp | acp start |
| <code>/restate</code> | restate the conversation since your last message (local, no model call) | opens a view | pause, resume, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, script, start |
| <code>/retire &lt;task id&gt;</code> | drop a task from the graph: /retire &lt;task id&gt;, the number the task tree shows | sets state | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/review [TARGET]</code> | review changes in this session: /review [TARGET] (a ref or A..B or A...B) | starts a session | acp, acp start, ask -i, child, next, pause, plan/ask, resume, script, start, steer | - |
| <code>/shells</code> | background commands this run started, and how they ended | opens a view | pause, resume, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, script, start |
| <code>/standing &lt;text&gt;</code> | set the goal the run returns to when the queue drains: /standing &lt;text&gt; | sets state | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/status</code> | run status: tasks, tools, cost, context, preset | opens a view | pause | - |
| <code>/stop</code> | stop the run now, as `agent6 stop` does (resumable) | controls the run | pause, run -i, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/task &lt;text&gt;</code> | queue work into the task graph: /task &lt;text&gt; (worked when the queue drains) | sets state | pause, script, steer | acp, acp start, child, next, plan/ask, resume, start |
| <code>/tasks</code> | the task graph with statuses | opens a view | pause | - |
| <code>/undo</code> | fork back to before your last message (the text returns to edit and resend) | starts a session | next, pause, resume, run -i, steer | script |
| <code>/watch</code> | show the last 20 audit events from this run | opens a view | run -i | - |
